text: The tenderer must hold a valid LUSA qualification (LUSA-patevyys) for the relevant trade.
The tenderer's turnover must be at least EUR 5,000,000 in the most recently closed financial year.
Supporting evidence should be submitted with the tender; certificates and financial statements may be requested for verification before contract award.
Handover of the asset register and associated documentation at the start of the contract, and the arrangements for keeping this documentation current thereafter.
Proposed service level targets (SLA) for response and completion of maintenance work, by priority category.
Method for inspecting the condition of the building envelope (roofing, facades, windows) as part of the annual maintenance cycle.
Commissioning and testing procedure to be followed after any equipment replacement or repair.
Warranty period offered on installed equipment and replacement parts.
Proposed contract period, including any extension options.
Tenderers must complete and return the Tender Form (Appendix 1) together with their technical and commercial proposal.
Price must be quoted in EUR/m2/year, not EUR/month.
Tenderers must state the unit basis applied to the maintenance pricing -- per property or per square metre -- and apply it consistently throughout the quotation.
Tenders must be submitted by e-mail to hankinnat@koskimyllynkiinteistot.example no later than 14 April 2026, 12:00 (Helsinki time). Tenders received after this time will not be considered.
Occupational safety plan (tyoturvallisuussuunnitelma) for work carried out on the properties.
Description of spare parts availability and delivery time for the equipment types covered by the contract.
CVs of the key personnel proposed for the contract.
